statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0, consistent with regulator-approved programs
Group CISO accountable; division security and compliance leads named
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up; business-side risks to CDAs given to the CSP risk process
Risk acceptance authority by level; CSP, SGI, and Part 37 deficiencies cannot be accepted
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Division inheritance of common controls documented and confirmed annually
No shared-service path to CDAs, SGI systems, the CIP ESP, or Part 37 security systems
Business-side changes touching CSP controls, maintenance, or security screened by the CST and under 73.58
Third parties under contract with security terms; access authorization vendor audit rights
Annual common control assessment and division samples
Retention for at least 6 years or as regulation requires
AI systems registered and approved before use
Unique identities; no shared accounts
Role-based least privilege; CDA work packages limited to approved roles
MFA for all workforce, remote, privileged, and customer administrator access
Cross-division access bound to dated assignments and ended automatically
Device check for station networks; division laptops in a contractor segment
Removal within 4 hours of termination and on assignment end
Need-to-know and trustworthiness determinations before access to SGI, access authorization files, and Part 37 information
Default passwords changed before connection; monthly default credential scans
Vendor remote access with named accounts, MFA, tickets, and recording
Annual review of admins bordering CSP networks for the 73.56 critical group
One severity scale; CSP-adjacent assets, SGI, CIP, and Part 37 events are Severity 1
SOC brings in the station CST within 30 minutes for CSP-adjacent activity
External reports about protected systems only through the program owner
Notification matrix kept and exercised across divisions annually
Disclosure committee within 24 hours of a Severity 1 declaration
No ransom without board decision, counsel, and OFAC check
Annual tests including a joint SOC and CST exercise
Lessons learned; CSP weaknesses to the CAP within 24 hours
SGI marked; cyber security sensitive label for CDA information
SGI reproduced only on evaluated equipment; never on networked devices
Automated SGI marking scan on uploads; removal and sanitization
External transmittals screened for cyber security sensitive content
Encryption in transit and at rest
Retention by the longest applicable rule; destruction that prevents reconstruction
PMMD only after kiosk scanning and as the CSP allows; vendor tools included
Report requests for CDA or security information at once
No SGI, CSP, access authorization, or Part 37 information in email, cloud, or AI tools
Generative AI not used in safety-related engineering until the QA procedure is issued
regulatory_driver: Client QA requirements (10 CFR Part 50, Appendix B, by contract)

statement_summary: Kiosk content released only after signature verification and a CST release step
No AI output creates a work request on Maintenance Rule equipment without human approval
Access authorization files only in the program repository with write-once retention
Vault security network separate from the business network with an alternate path
